name: mod.yagens_attributes.winter_talisman

capacity.description: Mod capacity used at level 0 and additional capacity per level. Total capacity cost is base + per_level * level.

max_level_description: Maximum inclusive Mod level. Level 0 is a usable Mod and every entry scales with (level + 1).

entries.description: Additive elemental coefficient relative to total original attack damage, including when this element is absent. A value of 1.0 means 100%; scales with (level + 1).
Fractional additive bonus at level 0. A value of 1.0 means +100%; scales with (level + 1).
